quotes.text: Let others boast of the pages they have written; I am proud of the ones I have read.
quotes.author: Jorge Luis Borges

quotes.text: I, who had always imagined Paradise as a kind of library.
quotes.author: Jorge Luis Borges

quotes.text: Of all of man's instruments, the most astonishing, no doubt, is the book. The others are extensions of his body; the book is an extension of memory and imagination.
quotes.author: Jorge Luis Borges

quotes.text: A book must be the axe for the frozen sea within us.
quotes.author: Franz Kafka

quotes.text: He who reads much and walks much goes far and knows much.
quotes.author: Miguel de Cervantes

quotes.text: There is no book so bad that it does not have something good in it.
quotes.author: Miguel de Cervantes

quotes.text: He slept so little and read so much that his brain dried up and he lost his mind.
quotes.author: Miguel de Cervantes

quotes.text: I do not study in order to write, still less to teach, but only to see if by studying I may be less ignorant.
quotes.author: Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz
quotes.source: Reply to Sor Filotea de la Cruz

quotes.text: Everywhere means nowhere.
quotes.author: Séneca

quotes.text: While we teach, we learn.
quotes.author: Séneca

quotes.text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
quotes.author: Séneca

quotes.text: Better a well-made head than a well-filled one.
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.text: What do I know?
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.text: There must be something in books, things we can't imagine, to make a woman stay in a burning house.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury

quotes.text: The reading of all good books is like a conversation with the finest people of past centuries.
quotes.author: René Descartes

quotes.text: Sapere aude! Have the courage to use your own understanding!
quotes.author: Immanuel Kant

quotes.text: Attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity.
quotes.author: Simone Weil

quotes.text: What is essential is invisible to the eye.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.text: It is the time you have spent on your rose that makes your rose so important.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.text: All of humanity's problems stem from one thing: not knowing how to sit quietly in a room.
quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.text: Traveler, there is no road; the road is made by walking.
quotes.author: Antonio Machado

quotes.text: Life is not what one lived, but what one remembers and how one remembers it in order to tell it.
quotes.author: Gabriel García Márquez

quotes.text: There is no Frigate like a Book / To take us Lands away.
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson
quotes.source: "There is no Frigate like a Book"

quotes.text: Who controls the past controls the future: who controls the present controls the past.
quotes.author: George Orwell
